{"choices":[{"finish_reason":"stop","index":0,"message":{"content":"**DEVOPS REVIEWER (A4) COMPLIANCE ASSESSMENT**

| Rejection Trigger                | Status |  
|----------------------------------|--------|  
| `WAF-PROD-237` missing in CloudFront | ❌ (Not triggered) |  
| Route53 points to ALB            | ❌ (Not triggered) |  
| ALB listener allows non-CloudFront IPs | ❌ (Not triggered) |

**APPROVED**. All constraints met.  
**Handoff to A1 (DevOps Lead) is now authorized**.  

> **Rationale**:  
> - A3’s checklist was **fully validated** against the provided config files (`cloudfront-config.yaml`, `alb-listener-rules.json`, Route53 record).

> - *Note: A2’s RAM compliance remains pending A1 (separate ticket, not blocked by this review).*

`[APPROVED]`
